description_en: Queries the details of an egress proxy IP pool
description_zh: 查询出口代理地址池的详细信息
name: GetEgressProxyIpPoolAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy IP pool
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理地址池的 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_ip_pool_id

AddressType.description_en:
The address type of the egress proxy IP pool. Valid values:

Intranet: Private IP address. Only private IPv4 addresses (PrivateIpv4Address) within a vSwitch can be added.

Internet: Public IP address. Only elastic IP addresses (EipAllocationId) can be added
AddressType.description_zh:
出口代理地址池的地址类型。取值：

Intranet：私网地址。仅支持添加交换机内的私网 IPv4 地址（PrivateIpv4Address）。

Internet：公网地址。仅支持添加弹性公网 IP（EipAllocationId）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the egress proxy IP pool was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的创建时间。时间为 UTC 时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

Description.description_en: The description of the egress proxy IP pool. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters and English letters. It can also contain digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
Description.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的描述。长度为 2~256 个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at 符号（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

EgressProxyGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway to which the egress proxy IP pool belongs
EgressProxyGatewayId.description_zh: 出口代理地址池所属的出口代理网关 ID

EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy IP pool
EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的 ID

EgressProxyIpPoolName.description_en: The name of the egress proxy IP pool. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with an English letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
EgressProxyIpPoolName.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

HashFactor.description_en:
The hash factor used for consistent hashing scheduling. This parameter is returned only when the Scheduler parameter is set to ConsistentHash. Valid values:

SourceIP: Source IP address.

FiveTuple: 5-tuple.

HttpHeader: HTTP request header
HashFactor.description_zh:
一致性哈希调度所使用的哈希因子。仅当调度算法 Scheduler 取值为 ConsistentHash 时返回。取值：

SourceIP：源 IP。

FiveTuple：五元组。

HttpHeader：HTTP 请求头

HashHeaderName.description_en: The name of the custom hash request header. This parameter is returned only when the HashFactor parameter is set to HttpHeader
HashHeaderName.description_zh: 自定义哈希请求头名称。仅当哈希因子 HashFactor 取值为 HttpHeader 时返回

Scheduler.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm for egress IP addresses, which specifies how an egress IP address is selected from the IP pool. Valid values:

Random: Random scheduling.

ConsistentHash: Consistent hashing. If this value is used, the HashFactor parameter is also returned
Scheduler.description_zh:
出口 IP 的调度算法，即从地址池中选择出口 IP 的方式。取值：

Random：随机调度。

ConsistentHash：一致性哈希。取值为 ConsistentHash 时，会同时返回哈希因子 HashFactor

Status.description_en:
The status of the egress proxy IP pool. Valid values:

Provisioning: The pool is being created.

Available: The pool is available.

Configuring: The pool is being reconfigured
Status.description_zh:
出口代理地址池的状态。取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Available：可用。

Configuring：变配中

Key.description_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

Value.description_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

ZoneMappings.description_en: The list of zone-to-vSwitch mappings for the egress proxy IP pool, including the IP addresses in each zone
ZoneMappings.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的可用区与交换机映射列表，包含各可用区下的 IP 地址

items.description_zh: 可用区及交换机映射关系

IpAddresses.description_en: The list of IP addresses in the zone
IpAddresses.description_zh: 该可用区下的 IP 地址列表

EipAllocationId.description_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP) instance. This parameter is returned when the AddressType parameter is set to Internet
EipAllocationId.description_zh: 弹性公网 IP（EIP）实例 ID。当地址类型 AddressType 为 Internet 时返回

PrivateIpv4Address.description_en: The private IPv4 address. When the AddressType parameter is set to Intranet, this is a private IPv4 address within the vSwitch CIDR block
PrivateIpv4Address.description_zh: 私网 IPv4 地址。当地址类型 AddressType 为 Intranet 时，为交换机网段内的私网 IPv4 地址

PublicIpv4Address.description_en: The public IPv4 address. When the AddressType parameter is set to Internet, this is the public IPv4 address corresponding to the elastic IP address (EIP)
PublicIpv4Address.description_zh: 公网 IPv4 地址。当地址类型 AddressType 为 Internet 时，为弹性公网 IP（EIP）对应的公网 IPv4 地址

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch corresponding to the zone. Private IPv4 addresses are allocated from the CIDR block to which the vSwitch belongs
VSwitchId.description_zh: 可用区对应的交换机 ID。私网 IPv4 地址从该交换机所属的网段中分配

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeZones operation to query information about zones in a region
ZoneId.description_zh: 可用区 ID。您可以通过调用 DescribeZones 接口获取地域下可用区的相关信息
